## Publishable package checklist

Only if this PR changes a published artifact:

- [ ] Version bumped in the package manifest
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for that package
- [ ] Followed [`.github/RELEASE.md`](RELEASE.md)

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused (no unrelated refactors)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Docs / README updated if user-facing behavior changed
